requirements.title: Liquid/serum skincare manufacturing experience
requirements.description: Manufacturing capability: documented experience producing liquid/serum skincare formulations (not solid or powder cosmetics only)
requirements.rationale: Serum filling requires liquid-fill line capability, distinct from solid-format cosmetics

requirements.title: ISO 22716 (Cosmetics GMP) certification
requirements.description: Holds a current ISO 22716 (Cosmetics GMP) certification
requirements.rationale: Regulatory baseline for cosmetics manufacturing; non-negotiable for retail listing

requirements.title: Maximum first-order MOQ
requirements.description: Minimum order quantity (MOQ) accepted is ≤ 5,000 units for a first order
requirements.rationale: Initial order is 8,000 units; supplier must be willing to accept an order in that range without forcing a much larger commitment

requirements.title: Maximum historical quality inspection fail rate
requirements.description: Historical quality inspection fail rate ≤ 30% across audited production batches
requirements.rationale: Reject rate above this threshold indicates unacceptable process variability for a new retail product

requirements.title: Maximum manufacturing lead time
requirements.rationale: Needed to hit the planned retail launch window

requirements.title: Facility location in India
requirements.description: Facility located in India (for this sourcing round)
requirements.rationale: Import/logistics timeline for this launch phase is scoped to domestic manufacturing only; cross-border sourcing is out of scope for this decision

requirements.title: Documented cruelty-free manufacturing declaration
requirements.rationale: Required for brand positioning and retail partner compliance
